If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is positive and price is trending down, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract downward bias.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is near support, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is positive and price is above 70, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for early horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is negative and price is below 65, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid horizon to avoid underestimation.  
If sentiment is mixed and price is volatile, apply 0.5–1.5% reduction for late horizon to dampen momentum-driven noise.
